caption:
This brewery doesn't exist. The website does.

Breaker Room Brewing is a concept build, a fictional BC taproom built to prove what a brewery website can feel like: eight beers, eight room states, a switchboard you can actually throw, and an age gate with manners.

Every pixel custom. No template anywhere.

Which Kootenay brewery deserves a site like this? Name them below.

#Kootenays #Castlegar #WebDesign #BCBusiness

Five decisions make Smokefall smell like woodsmoke, and four of them transfer to any kitchen in the Kootenays.

Smokefall is a concept build, a fictional wood-fired restaurant designed to prove the pattern: the site knows what time it is, the sun is draggable, the menu is real HTML set like a printed board, and the whole show still scores 97 on Google's own speed test.

Number five is the one every restaurant site skips.

Save this for your next redesign.
